recognized_test_commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "rm internal/cue/probe_test.go
cat > internal/cue/validate_result_test.go <<'EOF'
package cue

import (
 \"bytes\"
 \"encoding/json\"
 \"errors\"
 \"os\"
 \"path/filepath\"
 \"strings\"
 \"testing\"

 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

const invalidFields = "'`flags:
- ey: wrong
  nabled: true
  name: foo
  variants: []
  rules:
  - segment: x
    rank: 1
    distributions:
    - variant: v
      rollout: 110
segments: []
`

func TestFeaturesValidatorReportsEachField(t *testing.T) {
 fv,err:=NewFeaturesValidator();require.NoError(t,err)
 result,err:=fv.Validate("features.yaml",[]byte(invalidFields))
 require.ErrorIs(t,err,ErrValidationFailed)
 require.Len(t,result.Errors,3)
 expected:=map[string]Location{
  "flags.0.ey":{File:"features.yaml",Line:2,Column:3},
  "flags.0.nabled":{File:"features.yaml",Line:3,Column:3},
  "flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout":{File:"features.yaml",Line:11,Column:7},
 }
 for _,e:=range result.Errors {
  location,ok:=expected[e.Path];require.True(t,ok,"unexpected path %s",e.Path)
  require.Equal(t,location,e.Location)
  require.Contains(t,e.Message,e.Path)
  if strings.HasSuffix(e.Path,"rollout") {require.Contains(t,e.Message,"<=100")}
 }
}

func TestValidateFilesFormats(t *testing.T) {
 dir:=t.TempDir();file:=filepath.Join(dir,"features.yaml")
 require.NoError(t,os.WriteFile(file,[]byte(invalidFields),0600))
 var output bytes.Buffer
 require.ErrorIs(t,ValidateFiles(&output,[]string{file},jsonFormat),ErrValidationFailed)
 var result Result
 require.NoError(t,json.Unmarshal(output.Bytes(),&result));require.Len(t,result.Errors,3)
 require.Equal(t,file,result.Errors[0].Location.File)
 output.Reset()
 require.ErrorIs(t,ValidateFiles(&output,[]string{file},textFormat),ErrValidationFailed)
 require.Contains(t,output.String(),"flags.0.nabled")
 require.Contains(t,output.String(),file+":3:3")
}

func TestFeaturesValidatorValidDocument(t *testing.T) {
 fv,err:=NewFeaturesValidator();require.NoError(t,err)
 b,err:=os.ReadFile("fixtures/valid.yaml");require.NoError(t,err)
 result,err:=fv.Validate("valid.yaml",b)
 require.NoError(t,err);require.Empty(t,result.Errors)
 var output bytes.Buffer
 require.NoError(t,ValidateFiles(&output,[]string{"fixtures/valid.yaml"},jsonFormat))
 require.JSONEq(t,`{"errors":[]}`,output.String())
}

func TestFeaturesValidatorMalformedYAML(t *testing.T) {
 fv,err:=NewFeaturesValidator();require.NoError(t,err)
 result,err:=fv.Validate("broken.yaml",[]byte("flags: ['"\\n\"))
 require.True(t,errors.Is(err,ErrValidationFailed));require.NotEmpty(t,result.Errors)
 require.Equal(t,\"broken.yaml\",result.Errors[0].Location.File)
 require.Positive(t,result.Errors[0].Location.Line)
}
EOF
gofmt -w internal/cue/validate.go internal/cue/validate_result_test.go cmd/flipt/validate.go
go test ./internal/cue -count=1"

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
